messages:
sora: Sakura-v1-q5 int8 rollout noticed a reproducible drop on a vertical-JP smoke that mixes ruby furigana and embedded Hebrew punctuation. BLEU down ~3.7 on small set. anyone have context for ruby+rtl interactions?

mika: can you share a minimal repro and the smoke numbers?

sora: pasted small repro from staging: 
```
INPUT (vertical preserved):
漢[ふり]{ruby}״אבג״

REF: "Kanji (furigana) ״Hebrew״"
SAKURA-v0.9 (gold): "Kanji (furigana) ״Hebrew״"
SAKURA-v1-q5-int8: "Kanji״Hebrew״ (furigana)"

Eval summary: BLEU 30.2 -> 26.5 (−3.7), sample_failures 11/420
```

tokenizer-bot: Requested tokenizer trace and normalization log. Running with debug mode...

harry: quick diff of tokens from debug run shows ZWSP/ZWJ and the ruby-close token reorder.

mika: screenshots/diffs?

sora: token diffs below (escaped for readability):
TOKS v0.9: [漢][ZWSP][ruby-open][ふり][ruby-close][״][Hebrew][״]
TOKS q5 : [漢][ruby-open][ふり][ZWSP][״][Hebrew][״][ruby-close]

harry: that would explain why generator glues the punctuation next to kanji in q5 output. It looks like the normalizer moved the ZWSP.

mika: what changed recently? The q5 binary included our int8 kernel packing update, and there was a unicode-normalizer tweak merged around 3745550000 by @tera. We need to disambiguate.

sora: quick experiment: run q5 binary but with TOKENIZER_LEGACY=1 -> BLEU 29.8 locally (almost back to baseline). So old tokenizer normalization preserves token ordering.

ci-bot: CI smoke for sakura-v1-q5-int8: BLEU −3.5, chrF −1.6, flagged for vertical+ruby+rtl regression.

mika: plan: add opt-out flag for new normalizer and revert it on canary until we have a normalization that preserves ruby anchor positions. Add a regression test mixing vertical, furigana and RTL punctuation; include tokenizer traces as artifacts.

sora: filing INF-3410 and adding an example to the locale-smoke testset. I'll PR the opt-out and the regression case, assign @tera and @harry for review.

tokenizer-bot: Created INF-3410: "sakura q5 int8 ruby+RTL tokenization reorder" and queued extended-locale-smoke job.

mika: also add a short note in the release checklist to run targeted ruby+RTL smoke before canary promotion.

sora: will do. thanks all.
